problem.zh: 大多数企业在 AI 应用中仍停留在单点实验阶段，缺乏从基础设施到组织文化的系统性 AI 就绪度。
problem.en: Most enterprises remain stuck in point-solution AI experiments, lacking systematic AI readiness from infrastructure to organizational culture.

approach.zh: 以 AI 成熟度评估为起点，并行推进 GenAI 用例落地、ML 平台建设与 AI 治理框架搭建，三轨同步加速。
approach.en: Start with AI maturity assessment, then run three parallel tracks: GenAI use-case delivery, ML platform build-out, and AI governance framework.

outcomes.zh: 6 个月内建成企业级 AI 平台，12 个月内实现 3–5 个 GenAI 用例规模化上线
outcomes.en: Enterprise AI platform live within 6 months, 3–5 GenAI use cases at scale within 12 months

zh: AI 用例上线时间缩短 70%

problem.zh: 企业开发团队被碎片化工具链、漫长的环境准备和重复的运维工作所困，工程生产力严重受损。
problem.en: Development teams are trapped by fragmented toolchains, long environment provisioning, and repetitive ops work, severely damaging engineering productivity.

approach.zh: 设计并交付内部开发者平台（IDP），建立黄金路径、自服务门户与标准化 CI/CD 流水线，将平台作为产品持续迭代。
approach.en: Design and deliver an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) with golden paths, self-service portal, and standardized CI/CD pipelines — treating the platform as a product.

outcomes.zh: 开发环境准备时间从数天缩短至分钟级，部署频率提升 3–10 倍
outcomes.en: Environment provisioning from days to minutes, deployment frequency increase of 3–10x

zh: 首次提交到上线时间缩短 80%
开发者净推荐值提升 30 分
基础设施单开发者成本降低 40%
en: Time from first commit to production reduced 80%

problem.zh: 中央数据湖/仓架构已成为数据价值交付的瓶颈：数据团队过载、领域团队等待时间长、数据质量持续下降。
problem.en: Centralized data lake/warehouse architectures have become bottlenecks: overloaded data teams, long domain-team wait times, declining data quality.

approach.zh: 以数据网格原则为指导，将数据所有权下放至业务领域，构建联邦治理与自服务数据基础设施，逐步迁移关键数据产品。
approach.en: Following data mesh principles, decentralize data ownership to business domains, build federated governance and self-service data infrastructure, progressively migrate key data products.

zh: 数据产品识别与优先级

outcomes.zh: 数据产品交付周期从季度缩短至两周，数据复用率提升 3 倍
outcomes.en: Data product delivery cycle from quarters to two weeks, data reuse rate increased 3x

zh: 跨域数据集成成本降低 50%

problem.zh: 边界安全模型在混合办公与多云环境中已失效。企业面临身份泄露、横向移动攻击和合规审计压力。
problem.en: Perimeter security models have failed in hybrid-work and multi-cloud environments. Enterprises face identity compromise, lateral movement attacks, and compliance audit pressure.

approach.zh: 以身份为中心重新设计安全架构，实施微分段、持续验证与自动化事件响应，从身份、网络、应用、数据四层同步推进。
approach.en: Redesign security architecture around identity, implement micro-segmentation, continuous verification, and automated incident response across identity, network, application, and data layers.

outcomes.zh: 攻击面缩小 70%，安全事件平均检测时间从数周缩短至小时级
outcomes.en: Attack surface reduced 70%, mean detection time from weeks to hours

zh: 合规审计准备时间缩短 80%
安全事件响应时间缩短 95%

problem.zh: 传统职能型技术组织导致交付缓慢、责任不清、创新乏力。业务与技术的鸿沟持续扩大。
problem.en: Traditional functional technology organizations cause slow delivery, unclear accountability, and weak innovation. The business-technology gap continues to widen.

approach.zh: 将技术团队重组为以业务成果为导向的产品团队，建立 OKR 对齐、产品运营节奏和持续改进机制，并在 90 天内完成首批团队转型。
approach.en: Reorganize tech teams into business-outcome-oriented product teams, establish OKR alignment, product operations cadence, and continuous improvement — with first cohorts transformed in 90 days.

outcomes.zh: 首批产品团队在 90 天内完成转型，交付周期缩短 40–60%
outcomes.en: First product teams transformed in 90 days, delivery cycle reduced 40–60%

zh: 员工敬业度提升 20 分
en: Team autonomy from low to high

problem.zh: 运行超过 10 年的单体系统成为企业敏捷性的最大阻碍：变更风险高、扩展性差、运维成本持续攀升。
problem.en: Monolithic systems running for over 10 years have become the biggest barrier to enterprise agility: high change risk, poor scalability, and rising operational costs.

approach.zh: 采用绞杀者模式渐进式迁移，以领域驱动设计分解单体，构建云原生微服务并建立并行运行验证机制，逐步下线遗留模块。
approach.en: Use strangler-fig pattern for progressive migration, decompose monoliths with domain-driven design, build cloud-native microservices with parallel-run validation, gradually retire legacy modules.

outcomes.zh: 核心业务模块在 12–18 个月内完成迁移，零业务中断
outcomes.en: Core business modules migrated in 12–18 months with zero business disruption

zh: 部署频率从月级提升至日级
en: Deploy frequency from monthly to daily

problem.zh: 全球供应链频繁受到地缘政治、气候与需求波动的冲击，传统计划系统无法应对实时变化。
problem.en: Global supply chains are frequently disrupted by geopolitics, climate, and demand volatility. Traditional planning systems cannot handle real-time changes.

approach.zh: 构建数字孪生驱动的供应链控制塔，集成实时数据、AI 预测与自主决策能力，从可视到可控再到自主优化。
approach.en: Build a digital-twin-driven supply chain control tower integrating real-time data, AI forecasting, and autonomous decision-making — from visibility to control to autonomous optimization.

outcomes.zh: 端到端供应链可视性从 40% 提升至 95%，库存周转率提升 25%
outcomes.en: End-to-end supply chain visibility from 40% to 95%, inventory turnover increased 25%

zh: 供应商风险预警提前 14 天
en: Supplier risk early warning 14 days ahead

problem.zh: 企业碳中和承诺缺乏可量化的技术路线图。IT 碳排放占比持续上升，但多数企业缺乏测量和优化能力。
problem.en: Corporate net-zero commitments lack quantifiable technology roadmaps. IT carbon emissions continue to rise as a share, but most enterprises lack measurement and optimization capabilities.

approach.zh: 建立 IT 碳足迹基线，通过绿色架构、云优化与可持续软件工程实践，制定 3 年减排路线图并与业务目标对齐。
approach.en: Establish IT carbon footprint baseline, develop a 3-year emissions reduction roadmap through green architecture, cloud optimization, and sustainable software engineering — aligned with business goals.

outcomes.zh: IT 碳排放在 3 年内降低 30–50%，同时降低基础设施成本 20%
outcomes.en: IT carbon emissions reduced 30–50% in 3 years while reducing infrastructure costs by 20%

zh: ESG 报告准备时间缩短 90%
